meta.name: Pei Pidichirukku
meta.description: An irresponsible businessman gets trapped in a dangerous deal with a rival company, triggering a series of mysterious and life-threatening events. As he seeks answers, he discovers that his deceased wife's spirit is behind his troubles, while his daughter's spirit has been protecting him. Caught between two spirits, he must fight to save his life and protect innocent children from an impending danger.
